functions.description: Captures one user-selected screen or window only after PublisherStudio confirmation and the browser's current getDisplayMedia prompt.
functions.inputContract: No image path. The PublisherStudio user selects a screen/window in a fresh browser prompt.
functions.outputContract: A bounded PNG data URL and pixel metadata returned in the current WorkResult.
functions.securityContract: Always asks in LocalGPT, always asks in PublisherStudio, and always invokes the browser's current getDisplayMedia permission prompt. Saved permission cannot bypass it.
functions.organicUseCase: Eyes organ for current visual evidence.

functions.description: Records a user-selected screen or window for up to 15 seconds after PublisherStudio confirmation and a fresh browser prompt.
functions.inputContract: maximumSeconds 1..15 and optional audio flag; the user selects the capture source in the browser.
functions.outputContract: A bounded WebM data URL, duration and MIME type returned in the current WorkResult.
functions.securityContract: Always asks in LocalGPT, always asks in PublisherStudio, and always invokes the browser's current getDisplayMedia permission prompt. Saved permission cannot bypass it.
functions.organicUseCase: Eyes organ for current visual evidence.

functions.description: Reads the bounded status and result of a previously queued browser screenshot for the next council heartbeat.
functions.inputContract: Parameters matching: {"type":"object","required":["requestId"],"properties":{"requestId":{"type":"string"},"includeData":{"type":"boolean"}}}
functions.outputContract: A bounded JSON WorkResult associated with the original CorrelationId.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.description: Starts one debounced single-flight screen-reader session. The interval is clamped to at least 15 seconds.
functions.inputContract: Parameters matching: {"type":"object","properties":{"selector":{"type":"string"},"prompt":{"type":"string"},"intervalSeconds":{"type":"integer","minimum":15}}}
functions.outputContract: A bounded JSON WorkResult associated with the original CorrelationId.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.description: Stops a recurring screen-reader session by id.
functions.inputContract: Parameters matching: {"type":"object","required":["sessionId"],"properties":{"sessionId":{"type":"string"}}}
functions.outputContract: A bounded JSON WorkResult associated with the original CorrelationId.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.description: Queues mouse, keyboard, focus or a gesture in an enabled PublisherStudio browser tab. BrushStroke draws one path with the visible Picture Studio Brush tool.
functions.parameterSchemaJson: {"type":"object","required":["kind"],"properties":{"points":{"type":"array","minItems":2,"description":"Ordered points for kind BrushStroke only. Select Brush in Picture Studio and use selector #picture-studio-canvas. Coordinates refer to the full canvas bounds.","items":{"type":"object","required":["x","y"],"properties":{"x":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMaximum":1},"y":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMaximum":1}}}},"tabId":{"type":"string","format":"uuid"},"kind":{"type":"string"},"selector":{"type":"string"},"text":{"type":"string"},"key":{"type":"string"},"x":{"type":"number"},"y":{"type":"number"}}}
functions.inputContract: Pass the tabId returned by publisher.browser.view.inspect to keep input in the inspected tab. Automatic selection requires exactly one enabled tab. For BrushStroke, select Brush in Picture Studio, target #picture-studio-canvas and provide ordered normalized points.
functions.outputContract: A queued request id, tabId and status. Read the outcome with publisher.input.result.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.description: Queues a bounded read-only view of visible PublisherStudio controls, geometry and publication element identifiers in an enabled tab. Field values and passwords are excluded.
functions.inputContract: Optional selector and tabId. Omitting tabId requires exactly one enabled tab.
functions.outputContract: A queued request id, tabId and status. Retrieve visible roles, labels, element ids, bounds and viewport with publisher.input.result. Reuse tabId for follow-up input.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.description: Reads the status, bound tabId and bounded result of a previously queued browser input command.
functions.inputContract: Pass requestId. Optionally include the tabId returned with the queue receipt to check the target.
functions.outputContract: The command status, bound tabId and any result or error.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.description: Validates and renders a canonical OpenScadDocument/OpenScadNode graph through the existing registered renderer path.
functions.inputContract: Parameters matching: {"type":"object","required":["document"],"properties":{"document":{"type":"object"}}}
functions.outputContract: A bounded JSON WorkResult associated with the original CorrelationId.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.description: Returns bounded metadata and preview evidence for an existing workbook session without mutation.
functions.inputContract: Parameters matching: {"type":"object","required":["sessionId"],"properties":{"sessionId":{"type":"string"}}}
functions.outputContract: A bounded JSON WorkResult associated with the original CorrelationId.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.description: Creates a reviewable text insertion proposal. It never mutates a publication automatically.
functions.inputContract: Parameters matching: {"type":"object","required":["text"],"properties":{"target":{"type":"string"},"text":{"type":"string"},"reason":{"type":"string"}}}
functions.outputContract: A bounded JSON WorkResult associated with the original CorrelationId.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.description: Opens a bounded PublisherStudio text editor after approval, returns the user's saved text through the same CorrelationId, then closes the editor automatically.
functions.inputContract: A title, question and optional initial text. The human edits the value in PublisherStudio.
functions.outputContract: The exact user-saved text, ContentType and CorrelationId; the editor closes after Save & return.
functions.securityContract: Requires the receiving PublisherStudio frontend for every current request. Content is encrypted after MFA trust is established.
functions.organicUseCase: Human feedback organ for Council questions and reviewed text.

functions.description: Returns user-approved bounded HTML, DIV or document content plus an optional source URL for LocalGPT chat and other organic clients.
functions.inputContract: Requested html/div/document format, optional source URL and maximum character count.
functions.outputContract: Approved bounded content, format, optional source URL and truncation metadata.
functions.securityContract: Requires the receiving PublisherStudio frontend for every current request. Content is encrypted after MFA trust is established.
functions.organicUseCase: Approved document/web-content organ usable by LocalGPT and other 1-Wire clients.

functions.description: Returns the current domain, service and controller context for grounded council planning.
functions.inputContract: Parameters matching: {"type":"object","properties":{}}
functions.outputContract: A bounded JSON WorkResult associated with the original CorrelationId.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.description: Returns the installed PublisherStudio media conversion capability map. Runtime availability is appended by the media capability service.
functions.inputContract: Parameters matching: {"type":"object","properties":{}}
functions.outputContract: A bounded JSON WorkResult associated with the original CorrelationId.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.description: Returns the maintained PublisherStudio document, spreadsheet, picture, audio and video format families with current media-runtime availability.
functions.inputContract: Parameters matching: {"type":"object","properties":{}}
functions.outputContract: A bounded JSON WorkResult associated with the original CorrelationId.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: Allows LocalGPT to route dropped files only to PublisherStudio format families that PublisherStudio actually maintains.

functions.description: Returns same-origin documentation plus the live DevExpress RichEdit story-formatting profile and supported safe proposal contract over authenticated 1-Wire.
functions.inputContract: No parameters. The result is limited to public same-origin documentation routes and availability metadata.
functions.outputContract: Documentation status/routes plus StoryEditor editor engine, supported proposal markup subset and formatting contract. No sensitive paths or unreviewed document mutation.
functions.securityContract: Read-only and does not expose physical paths, private files or browser state.
functions.organicUseCase: Documentation discovery for LocalGPT, linked organic clients and the PublisherStudio help frontend.

functions.description: Inspect the most recent media conversion jobs (count set by OrganicPlugins:MediaTools:MaximumListedJobs) without disclosing local source paths.
functions.inputContract: Parameters matching: {"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false}
functions.outputContract: A bounded JSON WorkResult associated with the original CorrelationId.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.description: Inspect the current user-configured PublisherStudio media conversion profiles.
functions.inputContract: Parameters matching: {"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false}
functions.outputContract: A bounded JSON WorkResult associated with the original CorrelationId.
functions.securityContract: Requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.description: Requests cancellation of one in-progress PublisherStudio media conversion job after explicit PublisherStudio user confirmation.
functions.inputContract: Parameters matching: {"type":"object","properties":{"jobId":{"type":"string","format":"uuid"}},"additionalProperties":false,"required":["jobId"]}
functions.outputContract: A bounded JSON WorkResult associated with the original CorrelationId.
functions.securityContract: Requires a linked peer and the operator-configured PublisherStudio permission matrix; cancellation requires fresh frontend confirmation.
functions.organicUseCase: PublisherStudio organic capability.

functions.displayName: Read announced export or media file
functions.description: Returns one chunk of a large file announced by an approved publisher.publication.export or publisher.media.output request. Only the peer that requested the file can read it; the file is discarded after its last chunk or when its retention ends.
functions.inputContract: transferId from a Transfer announcement and the byte offset to continue from (0 for the first chunk).
functions.outputContract: transferId, offset, length, done and documentChunk (at most the 1-Wire file budget).
functions.securityContract: Read-only continuation of a file the user already approved. Only the requesting peer can read it; retention, file size and total retained bytes are bounded by OrganicPlugins:MediaTools settings.
functions.organicUseCase: Move website exports, multi-page archives and converted video to LocalGPT without a 1-Wire message size limit.

functions.description: Lists every PublisherStudio export path for linked agents: document kinds, publication and website export scopes and formats, the render export catalog, installed FFmpeg presets, saved conversion profiles, importable file families and the 1-Wire file budget.
functions.inputContract: No parameters.
functions.outputContract: Document kinds, publication scopes and formats, render catalog, FFmpeg availability, presets, profiles, import families and fileBudgetBytes. FFmpeg executable paths are not included.
functions.securityContract: Read-only discovery through the linked-peer permission matrix.
functions.organicUseCase: Discover which document, publication, website and media formats a media agent can request before choosing a capability.

functions.description: Queues one FFmpeg conversion of a file sent by the linked peer with an installed preset or an operator-saved profile after the user approves it in PublisherStudio. Read preset and profile ids from publisher.export.formats.
functions.parameterSchemaJson: {"type":"object","required":["fileName","mimeType","contentBase64"],"properties":{"presetId":{"type":"string"},"profileId":{"type":"string","format":"uuid"},"fileName":{"type":"string"},"mimeType":{"type":"string"},"contentBase64":{"type":"string","contentEncoding":"base64"},"options":{"type":"object","description":"Optional conversion options such as startSeconds, durationSeconds, width, height, scaleMode, frameRate, crf, videoBitrateKbps, audioBitrateKbps, audioSampleRate, audioChannels, disableAudio, disableVideo, normalizeAudio, deinterlace and outputFileName."}},"additionalProperties":false}
functions.inputContract: presetId (or profileId), fileName, mimeType and the source file as contentBase64 within fileBudgetBytes; optional options. Filter graphs and advanced FFmpeg arguments are refused unless OrganicPlugins:MediaTools:AllowPeerFilterAndAdvancedArguments is enabled.
functions.outputContract: jobId, presetId, status, progress, message, output file name and MIME type. Poll publisher.media.job, then read the file with publisher.media.output.
functions.securityContract: Linked-peer permission matrix plus a fresh PublisherStudio approval for every request. The source is bounded by the 1-Wire file budget and the preset must be installed.
functions.organicUseCase: Convert, trim, scale or transcode audio, video and image media for other media agents.

functions.description: Returns status, progress and output metadata of one PublisherStudio conversion job.
functions.inputContract: jobId returned by publisher.media.convert or publisher.media.jobs.
functions.outputContract: jobId, status, progress, message, output file name, MIME type and size, and the next capability to call.
functions.securityContract: Read-only; physical paths are never returned.
functions.organicUseCase: Follow a queued conversion until it completes.

functions.description: Returns the converted file of one completed PublisherStudio conversion job to the approved peer, within the 1-Wire file budget.
functions.inputContract: jobId of a completed conversion job.
functions.outputContract: kind (file extension), mimeType, fileName and either documentBytes or, above the 1-Wire file budget, a Transfer announcement (transferId, length, sha256) that is read through publisher.file.read. LocalGPT reads transfers itself, verifies the file and offers it as a Chat download.
functions.securityContract: Linked-peer permission matrix plus a fresh PublisherStudio approval because the file leaves PublisherStudio. Files above the 1-Wire file budget are refused with the setting name.
functions.organicUseCase: Hand converted media to LocalGPT Chat or another media agent.

functions.displayName: Build or refine an editable publication
functions.description: Normalizes a complete PublisherStudio document for download. Supply a new native publication or a revised copy of an existing file. The result is editable in PublisherStudio.
functions.parameterSchemaJson: {"type":"object","required":["publication"],"properties":{"publication":{"type":"object","required":["name","pages"],"properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"pages":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":"object"}}},"description":"Complete native PublisherStudio publication. Use $type first in polymorphic elements, such as text, image, shape, dataVisual, or panel. Preserve existing IDs when refining."}},"additionalProperties":false}
functions.inputContract: Complete native publication JSON with name and pages. A revised document can retain its IDs. Omit machine-local streaming settings.
functions.outputContract: Editable .pubstudio.json file with page count and MIME type, delivered through the linked peer file transfer.
functions.securityContract: Linked-peer permissions and PublisherStudio approval. Operates on the submitted copy without loading an editor session.
functions.organicUseCase: Build, refine and deliver an editable PublisherStudio document.

functions.displayName: Export publication, page, object or website
functions.description: Exports the open publication through the editor's own export path after the user approves it in PublisherStudio: one page or object as PNG, JPG or SVG, all pages as PNG/JPG (ZIP when several), a single-file HTML presentation or site, or a structured website ZIP.
functions.inputContract: scope page (png, jpg, svg; optional page), element (png, svg; elementId), pages (png, jpg), presentation or site (html), structured-site (zip); optional dpi and sessionId (required only when several editors are open).
functions.outputContract: kind, mimeType, fileName, pageCount and either documentBytes or, above the 1-Wire file budget, a Transfer announcement (transferId, length, sha256) that is read through publisher.file.read; or a clear failure that says what the user must open. LocalGPT reads transfers itself, verifies the file and offers it as a Chat download.
functions.securityContract: Linked-peer permission matrix plus a fresh PublisherStudio approval for every export. The export runs in the user's open editor, whose browser tab must stay visible while it renders, and is bounded by the 1-Wire file budget.
functions.organicUseCase: Deliver publication pages, objects and websites to LocalGPT and other media agents.

functions.description: Discover available methods on actual mounted PublisherStudio Panel/Div modules. Only module IDs, kinds and callable method names are returned; no data rows or entered fields.
functions.inputContract: Uses the current browser tab; no passwords, credentials, or arbitrary scripts.
functions.outputContract: Queued request ID; retrieve module inventory through publisher.input.result.
functions.securityContract: Existing linked-peer permission matrix and an explicitly enabled browser automation tab; module invocation also requires PublisherStudio human confirmation.
functions.organicUseCase: Discover executable functions of mounted Panel/Div Studio modules.

functions.displayName: Invoke Panel / Div Studio module function
functions.description: Invoke an explicitly approved method on one visible Panel/Div module in the connected PublisherStudio browser tab. The same runtime methods are used in standalone exports.
functions.inputContract: elementId GUID, one advertised method, optional bounded JSON value; no arbitrary browser JS.
functions.outputContract: Queued request ID; retrieve the verified function result through publisher.input.result.
functions.securityContract: Existing linked-peer permission matrix and an explicitly enabled browser automation tab; module invocation also requires PublisherStudio human confirmation.
functions.organicUseCase: Execute an approved function exposed by a mounted Panel/Div Studio module.

functions.displayName: Create spreadsheet or document (XLSX, CSV, Word, PDF, RTF, HTML, TXT)
functions.description: Creates one new native spreadsheet (CSV content) or text object in the open PublisherStudio publication after the user approves it in PublisherStudio. Approval is required every time. Use publisher.sessions.list first to see open sessions instead of asking a human for ids.
functions.inputContract: kind spreadsheet (XLSX) or csv with CSV content, or text (Word DOCX), pdf, rtf, html or txt; content (CSV for a spreadsheet, plain text for every document kind); optional title, presentation visible (default) or silent, page (1-based) and sessionId (required only when several editors are open).
functions.outputContract: created object id, kind, title, page and presentation, or a clear failure that says what the user must open. Visible selects the new object; it does not open the editor dialog.
functions.securityContract: Existing linked-peer permission matrix plus a fresh PublisherStudio approval for every request; saved permission cannot bypass it. Content is validated by the native spreadsheet and story validators.
functions.organicUseCase: Create a new spreadsheet or text document in the connected PublisherStudio publication.

functions.description: Read-only list of the open PublisherStudio editor sessions with id, publication title, page count and the spreadsheet and text objects (id, kind, title, page). Use this instead of asking the user for session ids.
functions.inputContract: No parameters.
functions.outputContract: sessions[] with id, title, pageCount, currentPage and objects[] (id, kind, title, page); empty when no editor is open.
functions.securityContract: Read-only; requires an explicitly linked peer and the PublisherStudio exposure/invocation permission matrix. Lists only titles and ids, no document content.
functions.organicUseCase: Discover open PublisherStudio sessions and documents without asking a human for ids.
